data: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.
If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.
This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.
When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.

You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.
Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
to give health to friendly Heroes.
Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
-10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up
Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.
When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.
Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
+0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling
Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.
Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.
There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks
On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks
Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.
Can be recast within a brief window.
On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
Silences enemies for 2s if close range
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage.
The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies.
The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path.
Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.
Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s
Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.
Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.
Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
+4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 8s to 9s, June 30th, 2026.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 45s to 35s, March 6th, 2026.
